name: Derived asset price on renewal (inherit Asset.Price, not catalog)
what_it_tests: A renewal quote line inherits its UnitPrice from the prior Asset.Price (the net price that was invoiced) via native pull, not a fresh pricebook lookup
proc_mechanism: Derived Products - Native Pull; Derived Pricing Filter (ItemIsDerived=true); QuoteAction(Renew) -> Asset.Price -> QuoteLineItem.UnitPrice (pre-COLA)
expected_behavior: Renewal line UnitPrice equals the prior invoiced Asset price, not the current pricebook entry
test_setup: Renewal quote, QuoteAction.Type='Renew', line refs prior-order Asset, same product

prior_run.actual: After live Force-reprice of Draft Renewal quote 0Q0WC000003FY2r0AG: Cobalt Strike line SourceAsset.Price=5900 -> Pre_COLA_Price__c=5900 (exact inherit) -> +6.2% COLA -> UnitPrice=NetUnitPrice=6265.8. beSECURE line SourceAsset.Price=206 -> Pre_COLA_Price__c=206 -> UnitPrice=218.772, while catalog ListPrice=0 (proves NOT a pricebook lookup).
prior_run.notes: V21 step Derived Products - Native Pull (41) -> Derived Products - Renewals (43), gated by Derived Pricing Filter (ItemIsDerived/Renew). Pre_COLA_Price__c captures the asset-inherited price BEFORE COLA, equal to SourceAsset.Price exactly on both lines. COLA Uplift on Renewal (steps 27-28, 6.2% CMDT Lookup) then lifts UnitPrice; that is intended downstream, not part of A-03's pre-COLA assertion. beSECURE catalog ListPrice=0 vs inherited 206 is the decisive proof of asset-inheritance over pricebook lookup. Verified on live Force-reprice (REST place isSuccess=true), not static read. defect_proven…
